messages:
anya: Morning async — quick SDK/quickstarts check:
• Done: merged PR #482 (node quickstart + ESM README), updated sampleapp Dockerfile, pushed test wheel for mac M1.
• Blocker: Windows packaging test failing on CI (artifact signing error).
• Today: cut SDK v0.8.1 after docs review, finalize sampleapp release.

samir: LGTM on #482. Can you add a changelog entry? I'll review #489 (doc fixes) after lunch. Also I added a retry for apt-get in CI to reduce flakes.

maria: I can take Windows packaging tomorrow. Can you paste the failing logs so I can repro locally?

anya: pasted logs from CI job:
```
Error: gpg: signing failed: Inappropriate ioctl for device
error: failed to sign file
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File 'setup.py', line 212, in <module>
    sign_artifact()
  File 'tooling/sign.py', line 47, in sign_artifact
    subprocess.check_call(['gpg', '--batch', '--sign', artifact])
subprocess.CalledProcessError: Command '['gpg', '--batch', '--sign', 'dist/sdk-0.8.1.whl']' returned non-zero exit status 2
```

maria: aha — looks like the runner doesn't have the GPG_TTY env set for non-interactive sign. Try adding `export GPG_TTY=$(tty)` in the signing step or use `gpg --batch --pinentry-mode loopback`. I queued a rerun: job #188.

devex-bot: CI job #188 rerun completed — artifacts signed and tests passed :white_check_mark: https://ci.redwood.ai/188

lee: small doc nit: embedding config still mentions `cache_enabled` — should be `prefix_cache` and mention `prefix_cache_size`. Filed #490.

samir: thanks @lee. I'll add the changelog and update the quickstart note about kernel selection (cc @eng-platform). That note affects default config when using continuous batching.

anya: thanks all. @maria if windows packaging looks good tomorrow I'll cut the release. Pinged reviewers @samir and @lee on #489.

maria: will take it tomorrow morning. Also +1 to add macos-latest & macos-11 wheel builds to the CI matrix to catch M1 issues earlier.

samir: :thumbsup: blockers mostly cleared. I'll review #489 in ~2h and add the changelog entry.

PRs & links: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/482  https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/489  https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/490
